# Docs PR Checklist

Use this template for documentation-related PRs (feature docs, README/FEATURES updates).

## Summary

- Briefly describe the documentation changes and the feature they cover.

## Pre-PR checks

- [ ] Reviewed `.github/copilot/FEATURE_DOC_PROCESS.md`
- [ ] Reviewed existing docs in `FEATURES/` relevant to this feature
- [ ] Verified `FEATURES.md` index is updated (Todo + Details link)
- [ ] Verified `README.md` Project Progress reflects important changes
- [ ] Cross-linked moved/related content between feature docs

## Changes

- Files updated/added:
  - [ ] `FEATURES/<Feature-Name>.md`
  - [ ] `FEATURES.md`
  - [ ] `README.md`
  - [ ] `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_doc.md` (if template changes)
  - [ ] Other:

## Notes

- Include any decisions, mapping examples, or acceptance criteria updates.

## Links

- Related issues/PRs:
- Screenshots (optional):
